containerOverrides.name: enterprise-rag-api
command: import os, psycopg; sql = "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS audit_logs (id BIGINT GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, user_query TEXT NOT NULL, answer TEXT, source_used VARCHAR(30), status VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'success', created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, retries INTEGER)"; conn = psycopg.connect(os.environ['DATABASE_URL'], connect_timeout=10); conn.execute(sql); conn.commit(); conn.close(); print('RDS audit_logs table created successfully')
